title: The Mermaid Inn
geometryBasis: Named inn point, street axis and selected outline, exact Qualla photo, two supplemental CC0 exterior photographs and original elevation.
sectionBasis: The south street elevation fans into two black-and-white wing fronts. A cobbled entry leads to a rear timber arch, enclosed yard, pitched tiled roofs, several dormers and brick chimney stacks.
limitations: The model represents the principal Mermaid Inn street wings and their inner courtyard in 2019. The shared building row continues into adjoining properties.
The street photographs determine the half-timbering, roof and chimney character. Exact property divisions at the rear, court and steps are approximate.
